name: Katekyo ~ Life
source:
Genjiro is a high school graduate who is preparing for another chance to enter a university. He is now studying hard and works part-time everyday to make a living. One day, Mei, his friend, mistakenly seduces him. They are about to have sex, but Genjiro somehow keeps his cool and stops her. But he, who is happy to know that she loves him, promises with her, "If we can enter the same university, we will become boyfriend/girlfriend." To make it, Genjiro needs to study and work hard. But Akiko, Mei's mother, and Kazumi, Mei's close friend, also approach him. Well, will he be able to shake off temptation and keep the promise...?

[From [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20090807102123/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/products_id/1012728]ErogeShop[/url]]
translation:
源次郎高中毕业后正在复读备考大学。他如今努力学习，每天还要兼职维持生活。一天，朋友芽衣误打误撞地开始诱惑他。两人差点发生关系，源次郎却设法保持冷静，及时阻止了她。得知芽衣爱着自己后，他十分高兴，并与她约定：“如果我们能考进同一所大学，就正式成为恋人。”为了实现约定，源次郎必须努力学习和工作。然而芽衣的母亲秋子，以及她的好友和美，也开始接近他。源次郎能否摆脱诱惑，遵守两人的约定？
